categories.main_business_segments: Yantai Zhenghai Magnetic Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: high-performance NdFeB permanent magnetic materials and new energy vehicle (NEV) motor drive systems. The company focuses on the research, production, sales, and service of these products, serving high-end applications such as new energy vehicles, energy-saving appliances, intelligent equipment, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced core technologies including Technology of Heavy Rare Earth Diffusion (THRED) and Technology of Optimizing Particle Size (TOPS). It emphasizes innovation in low and zero heavy rare earth content magnets, machine learning and AI in product development, and maintains a flexible, customer-oriented production model with customized, non-standard products. The company also capitalizes on its proprietary oxygen-free process and grain boundary modification techniques to enhance product performance and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include top global automotive brands, leading domestic car manufacturers, and major players in the energy-saving appliance and intelligent consumer electronics sectors. The company has established strategic partnerships with top 10 international automotive brands, top 5 domestic automotive brands, and leading new energy vehicle manufacturers. Emerging markets include humanoid robots and low-altitude economy sectors such as drones and eVTOL aircraft.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yantai, Nantong, and Jianghua. It has established marketing and service offices in Germany, France, Japan, South Korea, the United States, and Malaysia, enabling global market coverage and localized customer support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yantai Zhenghai Magnetic Material Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-performance NdFeB permanent magnets and components for downstream applications such as electric motors in new energy vehicles and other intelligent equipment. It sources raw materials like rare earth metals from upstream suppliers and supplies finished magnetic materials and components to OEMs and system integrators downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with dual R&D strategies: maintaining technological leadership ('high one step ahead') and optimizing rare earth resource utilization ('rare earth resource balance'). It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on reducing heavy rare earth usage, developing zero and ultra-light rare earth magnets, and advancing functional coatings. Collaborations with universities and national innovation centers support continuous breakthroughs, while digital transformation and AI integration enhance R&D and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized high-performance NdFeB permanent magnetic materials and components, as well as NEV motor drive systems. The company employs a cost-plus pricing model for its non-standard products and maintains a direct sales approach targeting end customers. It also earns investment income from financial asset management activities such as bank wealth management products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a global leader and one of the top enterprises in the high-performance NdFeB permanent magnet industry. It holds national manufacturing champion status and is a key player in China's strategic new materials sector. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, strong customer relationships, and a comprehensive global marketing network. The company faces intensified competition in the NEV motor drive system segment, leading to strategic business contraction in that area.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.54 billion, a 5.7% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 92.34 million, a 79.37% decline. Despite revenue contraction, the company achieved continuous growth in NdFeB magnet sales volume for seven consecutive years. The company has total assets of about RMB 8.78 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.95 billion, with a net asset return rate of 2.43%. It maintains a stable but challenging growth trajectory amid market and operational pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product performance characterized by low heavy rare earth content, high consistency, high working temperature resistance, and reliable coatings. Its products are tailored to meet stringent requirements of high-end applications such as NEVs, energy-saving appliances, and intelligent robotics. The company’s unique value lies in its advanced proprietary technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and ability to provide customized solutions that balance cost, performance, and sustainable resource use, positioning it as a strategic partner for leading global customers.
